articles.title: The quiet judge deciding the outcome of this year's mountain stages
articles.author: DANIEL MIRANDA
body: It's the latest sign of how quickly conditions have shifted in sports, where fans and analysts have had to adjust to a fast-moving set of circumstances.
There's no single figure that captures the full picture yet, though fans and analysts broadly agree the direction of travel matters more than the pace.
For now, fans and analysts are left weighing the near-term impact against what it could mean further down the line.
